name: Outline
short_description: Fast, collaborative wiki and knowledge base for teams.
description: Outline is a fast, collaborative, beautiful knowledge base for teams. Write documentation in a rich Markdown editor, organize with nested documents and collections, control access with teams and permissions, and search across everything instantly.
usecases: Build a team wiki with nested documents and rich formatting.
Document internal processes and share knowledge across teams.
Search and discover knowledge across your entire organization.
notes: Outline requires an authentication provider (OIDC, Slack, Google) to be configured via environment variables after deployment.
